variants.prompt: the wind-up pose: the whole grub presses itself down low, head lowered toward the ground, the two roots plunged down further (their lower ends still cut flat at the bottom). Same eye.
the attack pose: the front of the grub rears up and lunges forward to the right, the root-like mandibles spread wide open, the yellow-green eye glaring.

its second form: the white paper-like body looks wet and slimy with bright glossy highlights on every segment, more yellow-green sap veins running over it, the two torn holes wider, the eye bigger. Same size, same pose, same position.
